page.overview:
Who is Colonel Smithers?

Colonel Smithers is a character in the 1964 film Goldfinger. He is portrayed by Richard Vernon. He is in charge of the Bank of England.

Although Auric Goldfinger is a legitimate gold dealer, Smithers believes that he is also involved in gold smuggling, an activity which can affect the legal value of gold and thus that of major currencies including the American dollar and the British pound sterling.

When the usual methods of exposing Goldfinger's illegal activities fail, Smithers asks M and Bond to investigate. If they can prove his fraudulent activities, Smithers and the BoE will then seize Goldfinger's assets.

Smithers entrusts Bond with a German gold bar from World War II which he says was recovered from Lake Toplitz in Austria. Bond uses the gold bar during a golf match in order to antagonise Goldfinger.
